messages:
Move the JSON value helpers of JSON Patch to a shared module

JSON Merge Patch needs the same deep copy, JSON value validation and
prototype-safe member writes as JSON Patch. They move unchanged from
src/json-patch.ts to the internal src/json-value.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add JSON Merge Patch application (RFC 7386)

applyMergePatch(target, patch) implements the MergePatch algorithm of
RFC 7386 section 2 for clients that send partial updates in that format.
Like applyPatch, it works on copies, so neither argument is mutated and
the result shares nothing with them; it accepts JSON values only and
throws a JsonMergePatchError for anything else. __proto__ members are
defined as own members, not assigned.

Tests cover every example of RFC 7386 appendix A and section 3.
Documented in the README and ADR 0003.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
